DECLARE @intro nvarchar(max) DECLARE @tr_style nvarchar(max) DECLARE @header nvarchar(max) DECLARE @body nvarchar(max) DECLARE @err_header nvarchar(max) DECLARE @err_body nvarchar(max) DECLARE @err_hash_header nvarchar(max) DECLARE @err_hash_body nvarchar(max) DECLARE @err_rw_header nvarchar(max) DECLARE @err_rw_body nvarchar(max) set @intro = (SELECT CONCAT('

Environment: ',@ENV,' - [',@syn_workspace,']','

Workflow Name: ',@pipelinename,'

Process Date: ',CONVERT(VARCHAR,@datetoprocess,23),'

Start DateTime: ',CONVERT(VARCHAR,@run_datetime,120),'

End DateTime: ',CONVERT(VARCHAR,@end_datetime,120),'

')) set @tr_style = '' /***Summary Details***/ SET @header = '

Job Execution Summary:

' SET @body = (SELECT CONCAT(STRING_AGG(' 0 OR OTED.TASK_NAME IS NOT NULL) THEN 'class=''failed''' WHEN OS.STATUS IS NULL AND TD.DEPENDENT_TASK_NAME IS NOT NULL AND (COALESCE(TD.F_FLAG,0) > 0 OR TD.ERR_TASK_NAME IS NOT NULL) THEN 'class=''failed''' WHEN OS.STATUS IS NULL AND TD.DEPENDENT_TASK_NAME IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(TD.F_FLAG,0) = 0 THEN 'class=''disabled''' WHEN COALESCE(OCAD.ROWSSKIPPED,0) > 0 THEN 'class=''failed''' WHEN COALESCE(OCAD.ROWSREJECTED,0) > 0 THEN 'class=''failed''' WHEN OS.STATUS = 'RUNNING' THEN 'class=''running''' WHEN OS.STATUS = 'SUCCESSFUL' THEN 'class=''successful''' WHEN OTED.TASK_NAME IS NULL AND OT.TASK_NAME LIKE '%TSK_PRE_STG%' THEN 'class=''successful''' WHEN OS.STATUS = 'FAILED' THEN 'class=''failed''' else 'class=''failed''' END)+'>','') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY OTR.START_DATETIME,OT.TASK_NAME), '
Task NameStatusRejected Rows CountSkipped Rows CountStart datetimeEnd datetime
'+CAST(OT.TASK_NAME AS NVARCHAR(MAX))+''+(CASE WHEN OTED.TASK_NAME IS NOT NULL THEN 'FAILED' WHEN OS.STATUS IS NULL AND TD.DEPENDENT_TASK_NAME IS NULL AND OT.TASK_NAME NOT LIKE '%TSK_PRE_STG%' THEN 'DISABLED' WHEN OS.STATUS IS NULL AND TD.DEPENDENT_TASK_NAME IS NOT NULL AND (COALESCE(TD.F_FLAG,0) > 0 OR TD.ERR_TASK_NAME IS NOT NULL) THEN 'PRE-REQUISITE FAILED' WHEN OS.STATUS IS NULL AND TD.DEPENDENT_TASK_NAME IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(TD.F_FLAG,0) = 0 THEN 'DISABLED' WHEN OS.STATUS = 'SUCCESSFUL' AND COALESCE(OCAD.ROWSREJECTED,0) > 0 AND COALESCE(OCAD.ROWSSKIPPED,0) > 0 THEN 'SUCCESSFUL WITH REJECTED AND SKIPPED RECORD/S' WHEN OS.STATUS = 'SUCCESSFUL' AND COALESCE(OCAD.ROWSREJECTED,0) > 0 THEN 'SUCCESSFUL WITH REJECTED RECORD/S' WHEN OS.STATUS = 'SUCCESSFUL' AND COALESCE(OCAD.ROWSSKIPPED,0) > 0 THEN 'SUCCESSFUL WITH SKIPPED RECORD/S' WHEN OTED.TASK_NAME IS NULL AND OT.TASK_NAME LIKE '%TSK_PRE_STG%' AND COALESCE(OCAD.ROWSREJECTED,0) > 0 AND COALESCE(OCAD.ROWSSKIPPED,0) > 0 THEN 'SUCCESSFUL WITH REJECTED AND SKIPPED RECORD/S' WHEN OTED.TASK_NAME IS NULL AND OT.TASK_NAME LIKE '%TSK_PRE_STG%' AND COALESCE(OCAD.ROWSREJECTED,0) > 0 THEN 'SUCCESSFUL WITH REJECTED RECORD/S' WHEN OTED.TASK_NAME IS NULL AND OT.TASK_NAME LIKE '%TSK_PRE_STG%' AND COALESCE(OCAD.ROWSSKIPPED,0) > 0 THEN 'SUCCESSFUL WITH SKIPPED RECORD/S' WHEN OTED.TASK_NAME IS NULL AND OT.TASK_NAME LIKE '%TSK_PRE_STG%' THEN 'SUCCESSFUL' ELSE COALESCE(OS.STATUS,'UNKNOWN') END)+''+CAST(COALESCE(OCAD.ROWSREJECTED,0) AS NVARCHAR(MAX))+''+CAST(COALESCE(OCAD.ROWSSKIPPED,0) AS NVARCHAR(MAX))+''+COALESCE(CAST(REPLACE(CONVERT(VARCHAR,OTR.START_DATETIME,126),'T',' ') AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'-')+''+COALESCE(CAST(REPLACE(CONVERT(VARCHAR,OTR.END_DATETIME,126),'T',' ') AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'-')+'
') FROM OM.OM_TASKS OT LEFT JOIN OM.OM_TASK_RUN OTR ON OTR.TASK_NAME=OT.TASK_NAME AND OTR.PROCESS_DATE = @datetoprocess AND (CASE WHEN OT.TABLE_TYPE = 'SCD TYPE 2' THEN @run_datetime else OTR.CREATE_DATETIME END) >= @run_datetime LEFT JOIN OM.OM_COPY_ACTIVITY_DTL OCAD ON OT.TASK_NAME = OCAD.TASK_NAME AND OCAD.PROCESS_DATE = @datetoprocess AND OCAD.CREATE_DATETIME >= @run_datetime LEFT JOIN OM.OM_STATUS OS ON OTR.STATUS_ID = OS.STATUS_ID LEFT JOIN OM.OM_TASK_ERROR_DTL OTED ON OTED.TASK_NAME=OT.TASK_NAME AND OTED.PROCESS_DATE = @datetoprocess AND OTED.CREATE_DATETIME >= @run_datetime LEFT JOIN ( SELECT EDD.FULLDATE,OTD.DEPENDENT_TASK_NAME,OTED.TASK_NAME ERR_TASK_NAME,MAX(COALESCE((CASE WHEN COALESCE(EDD.MONTH_END,'N')='Y' AND COALESCE(OTD.MONTHEND,'N')<>'Y' THEN 0 WHEN OS.STATUS <> 'SUCCESSFUL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0)) F_FLAG FROM [OM].[OM_TASK_DEPENDENCY] OTD INNER JOIN [EDS].[DATE_DIM] EDD ON EDD.FULLDATE = @datetoprocess LEFT JOIN [OM].[OM_TASKS] OT ON OT.TASK_NAME = OTD.TASK_NAME AND coalesce(OT.BATCH_NO,1) = @BatchNo LEFT JOIN [OM].[OM_TASK_RUN] OTR ON OTD.TASK_NAME = OTR.TASK_NAME AND CASE WHEN OT.FREQUENCY_LOADING = 'WEEKDAYS' AND EDD.BUSINESS_DAY_FLAG = 'N' THEN EDD.PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY ELSE EDD.FULLDATE END = OTR.PROCESS_DATE AND OTR.STATUS_ID NOT IN (SELECT STATUS_ID FROM OM.OM_STATUS WHERE STATUS = 'FOR RE-EXECUTION') LEFT JOIN [OM].[OM_STATUS] OS ON OTR.STATUS_ID = OS.STATUS_ID LEFT JOIN OM.OM_TASK_ERROR_DTL OTED ON OTED.TASK_NAME=OT.TASK_NAME AND OTED.PROCESS_DATE = @datetoprocess AND OTED.CREATE_DATETIME >= @run_datetime GROUP BY EDD.FULLDATE,OTD.DEPENDENT_TASK_NAME,OTED.TASK_NAME ) TD ON OT.TASK_NAME = TD.DEPENDENT_TASK_NAME WHERE OT.SOURCE_CODE = @src_sys AND OT.DATA_LAYER LIKE '%EDS%' AND coalesce(OT.BATCH_NO,1) = @BatchNo ) /***Error Details***/ SET @err_header = '

Job Execution Error Details:

' SET @err_body = (SELECT CONCAT(STRING_AGG('','') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY OTED.CREATE_DATETIME),'
Task NameError DescriptionRun DateTime
'+CAST(OTED.TASK_NAME AS NVARCHAR(MAX))+''+CAST(ERROR_DESC AS NVARCHAR(MAX))+''+CAST(REPLACE(CONVERT(VARCHAR,OTED.CREATE_DATETIME,126),'T',' ') AS NVARCHAR(MAX))+'
') FROM OM.OM_TASK_ERROR_DTL OTED JOIN OM.OM_TASKS OT ON OTED.TASK_NAME=OT.TASK_NAME AND OT.DATA_LAYER LIKE '%EDS%' AND coalesce(OT.BATCH_NO,1) = @BatchNo WHERE PROCESS_DATE = @datetoprocess AND OT.SOURCE_CODE = @src_sys AND OTED.CREATE_DATETIME >= @run_datetime) /***Error Hash Details***/ SET @err_hash_header = '

Mismatched Source and Target hash totals:

' SET @err_hash_body = (SELECT CONCAT(STRING_AGG(' [Target] THEN 'class=''failed''' END)+'>','') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY INSERT_DTTM),'
FilenameRun DateTimeMetricsSource and Target Comparison
'+CAST([FILE_NAME] AS NVARCHAR(MAX))+''+CAST([INSERT_DTTM] AS NVARCHAR(MAX))+''+CAST(Metrics AS NVARCHAR(MAX))+''+(CASE WHEN [Source] = [Target] THEN 'MATCH' WHEN [Source] <> [Target] THEN 'NOT MATCH' END)+'
') FROM ( select *, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY [FILE_NAME],[Metrics],[DATE] ORDER BY [INSERT_DTTM] DESC) RNK from [EDS].[EDS_HASH_LOG_TBL] WHERE cast([Date] as DATE) = cast(@datetoprocess as DATE) and SUBSTRING([FILE_NAME],7,3) = @src_sys and [Source] <> [Target] ) SRC_HASHLOG WHERE RNK=1) SELECT CONCAT(@intro,@tr_style,@header,@body,@err_header,@err_body,@err_hash_header,@err_hash_body) as body;
